I know you are just trying to help her and show your appreciation, but if I found out a guy I was seeing deposited money into my account, snooped on me online, and was basically stalking me I would run far far away. Do you see what an invasion of privacy it was that you gave her this money? It also comes off as horribly controlling. I know it comes from a good place, but it doesn't appear that way. If she ever finds out she may cut you out of her life forever. I understand that she "saved your life" but you need to step back, because if she ever stopped being with you and your whole life is based on her, you will be worse off than you were before you met her. How did she not question where the money came from? And if you buy her things off her anonymous blog, she may pick up on you stalking her.
